boundary_path: pinned repository evidence (Boundary A) + data/imported/knowledge/<family>/<platform>/merged/ -> field-level source-truth comparison
method: gh api read-only calls against the real repository tree at the pinned SHA, cross-checked against data/imported/knowledge claims.json/README snapshots and this repo's own selection/corroboration code -- no local mutation, no target write

scout_claim_sample.result: 9/9 exact -- every sampled claim's text matched the real cited source file/line verbatim

format_support_false_positives.description: All 97 format_support scout claims cross-checked against their cited source file/line at the pin. 6 assert a positive capability whose cited method body is a NotImplementedError stub -- the claim is technically about a real class/method that exists, but the capability it asserts does not work.

examples.text: export support for Fbx via FbxExporter
examples.reality: raise NotImplementedError("FBX export is not implemented")

examples.text: export support for EntityFeatures via EntityRendererFeatures
export support for VariableManager via RendererVariableManager

format_support_false_positives.root_cause: the scout extractor pattern-matches method/class names (from_X, save/export, plugin class instantiation) into format_support claims without checking whether the method body is a real implementation or a stub. A correctly-working separate pass in the same run emits accurate limitation claims for the identical lines (e.g. CLM-3d-ced677 'Not implemented: EndPoint.from_radian'), so the false-positive and the true-negative claim coexist in claims.json at confidence 1.0.

contradicted_example.text: The Scene class provides a high-level API for loading, saving, rendering, and animating 3D content.
contradicted_example.reality: def render(...): raise NotImplementedError("render is not implemented")
contradicted_example.corroboration: the real README's own Scope and Limitations section states explicitly: this library reads, builds, and writes 3D scene data, it does not render or rasterize scenes
contradicted_example.assessment: LLM enrichment embellished a method signature it saw in the source snippet into a working capability the product does not actually have

stale_evidence_example.evidence_status: not_observable_in_repo (the cited snippet itself is not reproducible against the current source)

bundle_manifest_staleness.verdict: dead, unused data -- zero functional impact
bundle_manifest_staleness.evidence: aspose_knowledge_claims.py::load_bundle_provenance() reads only model.yaml; grep of 'bundle_manifest' across src/ finds only an unrelated concept in supervisor/trusted_cohort_restore.py. fleet_freshness_snapshot_stale_state.verdict: orphaned monitoring snapshot, not read by production code -- the real gate (assess_bundle_freshness()) correctly evaluates this bundle as current
fleet_freshness_snapshot_stale_state.evidence: grep of 'fleet_freshness|freshness_guard_state|freshness_snapshot' across src/ returns zero matches. assess_bundle_freshness() (aspose_knowledge_claims.py) compares model.yaml's repo_sha against the live-cloned source_revision only. The snapshot's own checked_at (2026-08-14T09:29:42Z) is 27 minutes before the pinned commit (2026-08-14T09:56:03Z) landed -- it was accurate when taken, simply never refreshed after the corpus was re-promoted 2.5 hours later.

negative_retention_check.verdict: no systemic bias against negative/limitation claims found
negative_retention_check.note: limitation claims carry the same maximal confidence as every other scout kind and strictly higher confidence than enriched marketing-adjacent kinds; each field (limitation, format_support, etc.) has its own independent selection cap (max 8) and never competes against other kinds for slots, so there is no cross-field mechanism suppressing negatives.
negative_retention_check.real_defect_found_instead: the shallow file-existence-only corroboration check (see format_support_false_positives) lets both a false-positive positive claim and its correct limitation counterpart survive selection simultaneously for the same underlying fact, risking a self-contradictory generated README -- a corroboration-methodology gap, not a negative-suppression bias.
